messages:
alex: heads up — pushed a prototype: metering-sidecar attaches to the edge proxy and stamps routing/context metadata onto metering events. goal: reduce misattributed tokens when fallback routing or region failover happens. want quick feedback on schema + perf tradeoffs.

maya: quick q — are we doing token counting in the sidecar or still at the model runtime? counting at edge seems tempting but we lose accurate KV-cache savings info.

isaac: +1 on counting at model runtime. sidecar should only enrich with routing metadata (route_id, fallback_reason, region, priority_tier, upstream_model_variant) and a stable event_id so we can de-dupe. token_count should be sent from runtime if available.

alex: agreed — runtime = single source for token accounting. sidecar adds routing metadata, client tags, and initial request_id. schema below (draft):

```json
{
  "event_id": "sha256(request_id + seq)",
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "source": "edge-sidecar",
  "route_id": "string",
  "fallback": "none|model_variant|region|capacity_tier",
  "fallback_reason": "string|null",
  "upstream_model": "gpt-x-8b-q4",
  "priority_tier": "free|paid|enterprise",
  "client_id": "string",
  "annotated_token_count": "int|null",
  "runtime_token_count": "int|null",
  "sampled": "bool",
  "tags": ["string"]
}
```

alex: sidecar will emit immediately to kafka topic `metering.enriched` and also write a small local fs buffer for short replay on broker backpressure.

ingest-bot: deploy: metering-sidecar v0.1 -> canary cluster (us-west-2) — build 0.1.3 — test run started.

maya: perf concern: adding sidecar per-request adds p95 overhead. can we batch enrichments or do async fire-and-forget? also worried about event size (tags + fallback_reason verbosity).

isaac: options: 1) async best-effort UDP-ish emit (no ack) for high-volume public routes; 2) reliable produce for paid/enterprise; 3) sampling for public free-tier. That keeps p95 on critical paths.

tina: dedupe rules: rely on event_id + request_id + ingest_window. we need idempotency on ingest side too. propose ingest consumer compute `dedupe_key = sha256(event_id + route_id)` and ignore duplicates within 24h. also need reconciliation job that compares runtime_token_count vs annotated_token_count daily.

maya: dashboard question — product wants invoice-friendly fields. we should include `billing_source` = {"edge_enrich"|"runtime_canonical"} and `billing_priority` mapped from priority_tier so finance can map to SKU. can we avoid freeform strings so metrics/dashboards don't explode?

alex: yes — fixed enum sets. will add `billing_source` and `billing_sku_hint` (e.g., embedding.compute, chat.standard). also compress fallback_reason into codes.

isaac: how do we handle chained fallbacks (a request that falls from region -> model_variant -> capacity_tier)? need an ordered list or last effective fallback only? last-only will be simpler for invoicing but we lose the path. maybe store `fallback_history` as compressed bitmask or short array when sampled.

alex: store `last_fallback` always; store `fallback_history` only when `sampled: true`. keeps event small normally.

tina: rollout plan: gate enrichment behind feature flag `metering_sidecar_enrich`. Canary: 5% orgs (include enterprise customers for reliability). After 48h SLI checks (recon drift <0.2%, no >1% added latency for paid routes) increase to 25% then 100%.

maya: add telemetry metrics: `metering.emit_latency_ms`, `metering.enqueue_failures`, `metering.buffer_spill_count`, `metering.sampled_ratio_by_route`. dashboards need alerts for spike in `enqueue_failures` or reconciliation delta.

isaac: SQL example for finance dashboard (draft):

```sql
SELECT billing_sku_hint, priority_tier, route_id, sum(coalesce(runtime_token_count, annotated_token_count)) AS tokens, count(DISTINCT client_id) AS customers
FROM metering.enriched_events
WHERE event_time >= current_date - interval '30 days'
  AND sampled = false
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

alex: good. also adding a nightly reconciliation job that joins `invoices` with `enriched_events` and emits `recon_delta_pct` per customer. alert if >2% for top 100 customers.

tina: question on backlog: when kafka is down and sidecar buffers to disk, how many events max can we store? need a cap and backpressure signal to edge so we can switch to sampling mode automatically.

alex: planning: buffer cap 50k events per node (~2GB). when >60% cap, flip to sampling mode and emit `metering.mode=sampling` metric. will surface in routing dashboard.

maya: please add a small UX improvement: Console should show per-route metering health (ingest lag, sampled rate, last processed event time) so SREs and AMs can triage billing concerns quickly.

alex: agreed — will add a `Metering > Route Health` panel in Console with those three widgets + quick link to reconciliation logs. docs: https://redwood.internal/eng/platform/metering-sidecar (WIP).

isaac: last note: test vectors. please add fuzz tests where runtime_token_count is `null` (old runtime) and sidecar annotated_token_count exists — reconciliation must pick the best source (prefer runtime if present).

alex: thanks all — moving canary to 25% tomorrow at 07:00 PST. monitoring dashboard URL will be posted here. :eyes:

ingest-bot: canary escalation watch set for 48h starting 2324509876.
